gen-dafont-franchise-gf-kadwa: Strong, clean Franchise packs its letters shoulder to shoulder, humming across the line with a soft, featureless texture. Kadwa, a serif, does the opposite job, its open-ended curves and generous x-height making body text easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-noticia-text: Franchise draws every stroke like a neon tube, with strong, clean letters jammed against their neighbors. But Noticia Text, a serif, relaxes the mood with big curve entrances and lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-piazzolla: Franchise sets strong, clean letters shoulder to shoulder, its t carrying a crossbar as weighty as its stem. And Piazzolla steps in underneath, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e pried open like a clasp.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-pridi: Tight and punchy: Franchise crowds its strong, clean letters together with no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere. Pridi, a serif, lets paragraphs unfold gently, its generous curve openings and proud, almost capital-sized lowercase keeping every line legible.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-scope-one: Scope One, a serif, spills its counters out into the surrounding space and sets stubby ascenders against a big x-height. Under Franchise, wire-like and strong, paragraphs settle into a traditional, refined rhythm.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-suwannaphum: Franchise jams its strong letters up against one another, each o drawn with sides and top equally thick. Suwannaphum, a serif, brings a bent-paperclip c and a high, squared-off x-height that make a page of text feel dignified.
gen-dafont-franchise-switzer: Packed and punchy, Franchise jams its letters together while keeping its c tips pulled well apart. Then Switzer, a sans, goes approachably Swiss, its tubular, wire-like letters and high waist line loosening the mood.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-domine: Domine brings compact ascenders and a slight pinch where curves meet stems. Galaxy does the glowing, a neon-glass tube of commanding line, while Domine quietly handles the reading with open curves.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-esteban: Galaxy draws every letter with an uninterrupted line, no hairlines and no swells, loose and cosmic across the page. Esteban, a serif, adds the restrained swell of a barely pressed brush, with a wide-open e that never squeezes shut.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa sets sturdy, large-looking lowercase with a lightly flexed spring-wire contrast. Galaxy cuts every stroke like wire, loose and commanding, a loud counterpart to the body's gentler, spring-like contrast.
